name: riv-lakehouse-demo
description: RIV 2026 Snowflake + AWS lakehouse demo: per-user S3 bucket and IAM role in the SE Sandbox, catalog-linked databases over AWS Glue (Lake Formation) and Amazon S3 Tables Iceberg tables, a Snowflake-managed dynamic Iceberg table, semantic view and Cortex Agent in CoWork, plus a guarded micro-batch Lambda runner.
